# OKF v0.1 bundle fixture

A bundle in the shape Ogham v0.18 and v0.19 wrote (OKF v0.1, graph version 1),
written by hand in that shape so the importer's legacy reads are tested
against fixed bytes, not against the current exporter. Used by
`tests/test_okf_v03.py`. Do not regenerate it with the current exporter.

This README has no frontmatter, so it is not a concept (OKF §3.2) and the
importer must skip it.
